age.Description: Age of the participant at time of testing

sex.Description: Sex of the participant, transcribed from the 'Sex' column of the source patient table kjm_ECoGLibrary_PatientTaskTable.pdf (Stanford Digital Repository zk881ps0522; MD5 a320c5dbfc826fd390317e45426fef27), keyed by the source two-letter patient code. Every non-n/a value agrees with the per-task source README tables that list the same patient (fingerflex, gestures, fixation_PAC, fixation_pwrlaw, joystick_track, mouse_track). n/a where the source table leaves the cell blank (HH, IN, JF, JT, RR, WW).
